connector.name: Pqs MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: PQS scores any prompt before the model runs. 8 dimensions. 5 frameworks. Pre-flight, not post-hoc.
connector.summary: Hosted at promptqualityscore.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package pqs-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the onchainaiintel account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PQS_API_KEY
env.description: Your PQS Pro API key (pqs_live_xxx) for optimize_prompt. score_prompt is free and requires no key. Subscribe at promptqualityscore.com/pricing.
